descriptionChirho: The radiant magnificence, honor, or splendor attributed to God, Christ, or reflected in creation and human dignity; uniformly rendered 'glory' (eng), 'gloria' (spa), 'महिमा' (hin), 'مجد' (arb), '영광' (kor), 'utukufu' (swa) across all 167 occurrences. The three clusters represent purely inflectional variation: singular across all four cases (S65819, 163x), accusative feminine plural (S65821, 3x meaning 'glories'), and dative singular (S65824, 1x 'in glory'). Every translation language uses the same root word regardless of cluster, confirming a single unified sense.
